# AI Test Workbench (`ai-test-workbench` / `aitw` v6.3.0)

> Trustworthy Verification Kernel & AI-Agent-First native multi-protocol MCP Server (`stdio`, Streamable HTTP `/mcp`, Legacy HTTP+SSE `/sse`) for Playwright E2E/API verification. Zero runtime third-party dependencies. Supports Chinese-default docs with paired English `.en.md` docs.

## Core v6.3.0 Capabilities
- **Authoritative 4-Layer Anti-Fake-Green Gate Kernel v2.2 (`src/kernel/gate-kernel.mjs`, `src/kernel/gate/rules/`, `src/governance.mjs`, `src/ledger.mjs`)**: Pluggable `AITEST-G101..G117` semantic AST rules (SymbolTable v2.1, scoped `AITEST-G110` conservation for edits inside pre-existing `if` blocks, governance-locked `customMatchers` schema & structured custom domain matcher recognition in `lattice.mjs`, `AITEST-G116` HTTP status equivalence, `AITEST-G117` Dieselgate guard), fail-closed sticky-T1 `.aitest/governance.lock`, signed `.aitest/baseline-ref`, and ULID `Run Ledger` binding (`FGER-internal = 0.0%`, `FGER-holdout = 0.0%`, `FGER-agentic_T2 = 0.0% (0/18)`, frozen `v6.0` blind unseen holdout FPR `6.1% (3/49)`, `v6.3.0` post-hoc 100-commit regression corpus FPR `4.1% (4/97)`).
- **Zero-Dep Performance & Native Multi-Protocol MCP Server (`src/doctor.mjs`, `src/impact/`, `src/codemap/`, `src/mcp/`, `src/jobs.mjs`)**: Zero runtime npm dependencies; parallelized `doctor` external tool probing (`~3x` faster), single-pass O(1) in-memory reverse import-graph indexing with comment stripping (`10,000`-file capacity) and parallelized Git diff queries; MCP `2024-11-05`..`2025-11-25` with **16 canonical typed tools**, in-process read-only fast paths for `aitest_impact` and `aitest_report` (preserving workspace root bounds & redaction), subprocess job isolation (`syncBudgetMs`) for mutating/compiler/browser tools, and linear-time ReDoS-hardened redaction & explorer safety (`src/core/redact.mjs`, `src/explore/safety.mjs`).
- **One-Call Change Verdict, Ledger-Bound Case Traceability & Differential Diagnostics (`src/verdict.mjs`, `src/heal.mjs`, `src/traceability.mjs`, `src/diagnose.mjs`, `src/report.mjs`)**: `aitest_verify_change` emits `attestation.json` (in-toto v1 + T0/T1/T2 with strict X.509/Fulcio verification), `verdict-summary.md`, and `verdict.sarif.json`; `aitest_report(view="summary"|"artifacts"|"flaky"|"traceability")` supports case-level `REQ-xxx` traceability bound to `.aitest/runs/latest.json` (`runId`/`ledgerBound`); `aitest_diagnose` classifies historical `regressionHistory` (`new-regression` | `persistent-failure` | `intermittent-flaky` | `first-observed`) from the Run Ledger; `aitest_heal(action="begin"|"attempt"|"conclude"|"discard")` hard-blocks Class B/C/D test edits (`0.0%` mis-heal rate).
- **Zero-to-One Loopback Bootstrap, Import-Graph Impact, Living Code Map & Default-Deny Explorer (`src/bootstrap.mjs`, `src/impact.mjs`, `src/codemap.mjs`, `src/explore.mjs`)**: `aitest_bootstrap` auto-detects loopback servers with runtime config validation; static reverse `import` dependency graph with `why` provenance; default-deny read-only exploration with 10-hop redirect firewall and Redaction v3; preserved `:id`/`[id]` dynamic routes and automatic defect convergence.
- **Template Manifest & Hash-Safe Upgrade (`src/upgrade.mjs`, `src/core/config.mjs`)**: One-way vendor mirror (`templates/playwright-qa/support/`) stamped with SHA-256 digests, idempotent `init`/`upgrade` preserving governance lock hashes, and schema-validated centralized configuration.
- **PerformanceObserver Web Vitals, WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 & JSON Schema Contracts (`src/perf.mjs`, `base.ts`, `src/kernel/schema-validator.mjs`)**: Real `LCP / CLS / INP` median & P75 capture, guarded `page.request` + `context.request` + allowlist egress, active W3C `traceparent` correlation, and `100%` seeded-defect detection (`7/7`).
